30. An excess of sodium sulfate was added to a solution of a barium compound to precipitate all the barium ions as barium sulfate, BaSO4. (GFM of BaSO4 = 233·4 g).

How many grams of barium are in 0·458 g of the barium compound if a solution of this sample gave 0·513 g of BaSO4 precipitate?

  1. 0·032 g
  2. 0·055 g
  3. 0·269 g
  4. 0·302 g

ans.why: n(BaSO_4) = 2.33/233.4 = 0.0100 mol = n(metal sulfate); GFM = 1.60/0.0100 = 160 g, which is CuSO_4 (159.6).
